min-max scaling for CRs
```{r}
library(dplyr)
FRSTGA <- FRSTGA %>%
  mutate(CR_scaled = (cooling_rate - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                     (max(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE) - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)))
FRSEEP <- FRSEEP %>%
  mutate(CR_scaled = (cooling_rate - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                     (max(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE) - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)))
FRFRIE <- FRFRIE %>%
  mutate(CR_scaled = (cooling_rate - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                     (max(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE) - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)))
FRHOCH <- FRHOCH %>%
  mutate(CR_scaled = (cooling_rate - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                     (max(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE) - min(cooling_rate, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

removing outliers
```{r}
remove_outliers <- function(data, column_name) {
  q1 <- quantile(data[[column_name]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(data[[column_name]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  
  return(subset(data, data[[column_name]] >= lower_bound & data[[column_name]] <= upper_bound))
}

FRIEhigh_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(FRIEhigh_8, "CR_scaled")
FRIElow_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(FRIElow_8, "CR_scaled")

SEEPlow_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(SEEPlow_8, "CR_scaled")
SEEPhigh_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(SEEPhigh_8, "CR_scaled")

STGAhigh_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(STGAhigh_8, "CR_scaled")
STGAlow_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(STGAlow_8, "CR_scaled")

HOCHhigh_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(HOCHhigh_8, "CR_scaled")
HOCHlow_8_filtered <- remove_outliers(HOCHlow_8, "CR_scaled")
```

sa tackicama, 3 plots, weather conditions together:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
library(svglite)

create_combined_plot <- function(high_data, low_data, park_name, 
                                theme_fill, high_border, low_border,
                                y_min, y_max) {
  # include only the first 8 hours after sunset
  high_filtered <- subset(high_data, time_after_sunset <= 8)
  low_filtered <- subset(low_data, time_after_sunset <= 8)
  
  # Hour groups (0-1)
  high_filtered$hour_group <- factor(floor(high_filtered$time_after_sunset),
                                    levels = 0:8,
                                    labels = 0:8)
  
  low_filtered$hour_group <- factor(floor(low_filtered$time_after_sunset),
                                   levels = 0:8,
                                   labels = 0:8)
  
  # Add condition column to each dataset
  high_filtered$condition <- "High Wind/Cloud Cover"
  low_filtered$condition <- "Low Wind/Cloud Cover"
  
  # Calculate mean values for each hour and condition for diamond placement
  hour_means <- rbind(
    aggregate(CR_scaled ~ hour_group, high_filtered, mean),
    aggregate(CR_scaled ~ hour_group, low_filtered, mean)
  )
  
  # Combine the datasets
  combined_data <- rbind(high_filtered, low_filtered)
  
  # Create combined plot
  plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = hour_group, y = CR_scaled, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
    # Add violin plot with adjusted position dodge and width for wider violins
    geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
                alpha = 0.7, 
                width = 1.2,            # Width to prevent overlap
                scale = "width",        # Ensure violins are properly scaled
                trim = FALSE) +         # Don't trim the tails
    
    # Add boxplot inside the violin for quartiles (without mean diamonds)
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
                alpha = 0.7, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
    
    # Add jittered points for individual data points
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8),
                size = 0.7, alpha = 0.25) +
    
    # Customize colors: same fill but different borders for high/low conditions
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("High Wind/Cloud Cover" = theme_fill, "Low Wind/Cloud Cover" = theme_fill)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("High Wind/Cloud Cover" = high_border, "Low Wind/Cloud Cover" = low_border)) +
    
    # Enforce common y-axis limits
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max)) +
    
    # Customize appearance
    labs(
      title = paste0(park_name),  
      x = "Hours After Sunset",
      y = expression(paste("Cooling Rate (K/h)"))  # Using expression for proper superscript
    ) +
    
    # Use a clean theme with minimal internal lines
    theme_minimal() +
    
    # Customize theme elements
    theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
  axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0)),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10),
  # Remove aspect.ratio to let plots fill available space
  # aspect.ratio = 0.6,
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray", size = 0.2, linetype = "dotted"),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
)
  
  # Add mean diamonds for each hour (one between the violins)
  for (i in 0:8) {
    # Calculate overall mean for this hour (combined high and low)
    hour_data <- subset(combined_data, hour_group == i)
    if (nrow(hour_data) > 0) {
      mean_val <- mean(hour_data$CR_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Add a diamond at the center of the hour position
      plot <- plot + 
        annotate("point", x = i + 1, y = mean_val,  # i+1 because factor levels start at 1
                shape = 23, size = 2, fill = "white", color = "black")
    }
  }
  
  return(plot)
}
```
